title: Transfer - Reliability Lab Stress-Screen Failure Normalization
goal: Normalize reliability lab stress-screen failure notes from thermal cycle, vibration, and burn-in experiments into a reliability failure reason codebook, using test phase and bench context to map noisy remarks to standardized causes.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfer moves the skill into reliability engineering, where the same normalization capability remains the only key requirement: segmenting unstructured failure notes, matching them to a scoped codebook, and calibrating confidence for uncertain cases.
